name: hrm-system
description: Multi-tenant HR + Payroll + Attendance SaaS platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,employee,admin,platform,mobile -c blue,cyan,yellow,magenta,gray "npm run dev:api" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/health -t 60000 && npm run dev:web" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/health -t 60000 && npm run dev:admin" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/health -t 60000 && npm run dev:platform" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 -t 120000 && node scripts/start-mobile.js"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hrm/shared-types && npm run build -w @hrm/api && npm run build -w @hrm/admin && npm run build -w @hrm/web && npm run build -w @hrm/platform
scripts.lint:ci: npm run lint:ci -w @hrm/api && npm run lint:ci -w @hrm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hrm/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @hrm/api && npm run typecheck -w @hrm/web && npm run typecheck -w @hrm/admin && npm run typecheck -w @hrm/platform && npm run typecheck -w @hrm/shared-types
